rationale: Describes connecting online and offline marketing, reporting, and integration with Adobe Experience Cloud and Creative Cloud, which are conventional marketing-platform functions. 'Personalization' is an unexplained benefit with no described mechanism, and the description is too thin to support a supported negative, so the label is weak and forced.
evidence_spans: connects your online and offline marketing to improve speed, efficiency, personalization, and reporting
by integrating with other powerful technologies from Adobe Experience Cloud and Creative Cloud.
